# Assuming you have the data in a DataFrame df
df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Inspection ID'])  # Convert Inspection ID to date format
df['Facility Type'] = 'Unknown'  # Add a placeholder for facility type

# Find the most recent inspection for each unique Facility Type
most_recent = df.groupby('Facility Type')['Date'].max()

# Join the most recent dates back to the original DataFrame
df = df.merge(most_recent, on='Facility Type', how='left')

# Now you can filter for the most recent inspection at each facility type
facilities = df[df['Date'] == df['Date_y']]  # 'Date_y' is the original date column
facilities['Inspection ID']  # This will give you the Inspection ID of the most recent inspection at each facility type
